name: VoxtMini
description: macOS voice input: press a shortcut in any app, speak, and local Qwen3-ASR models on MLX (Whisper experimental) type, translate or rewrite the text at your cursor.
compatibility: Speech runs locally with Qwen3-ASR on MLX, with Whisper (experimental: no live text, not yet run on a Mac with VoxtMini) or with Apple Speech; clean-up, translation and rewriting use local language models such as Qwen3.5 and Hy-MT2.
A remote service (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, DeepSeek and others) or Ollama and LM Studio on the same Mac can be chosen per feature instead of the local default.
limitations: Needs macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon; 16 GB of memory is recommended for the recommended models.
Beta software; models download on first use from Hugging Face. Whisper is experimental, and Apple Speech and Apple Intelligence have not yet been checked on real hardware.
Needs the Microphone permission, and Accessibility to type into other apps.

No account and no analytics. Installed builds check actnow.dev once a day for updates (/updates/voxtmini) and poll actnow.dev/api/voxtmini/notifications at launch and every six hours for announcements, sending only the app language and version (VOXTMINI_ANNOUNCEMENTS_URL="" turns this off); feedback and diagnostics are sent to actnow.dev only when the user sends them from the feedback window.
Official builds bundle React Bits Sound Lab cue sounds (MIT + Commons Clause v1.0, from a private library, not under Apache-2.0); builds from source play macOS system sounds instead.
